title: Find common factors
text: Rewrite the fraction in terms of common factors in the numerator and denominator. \n $$\frac{9x}{6-6x}=\frac{3(3x)}{3(2-2x)}$$

title: Cancellation
text: We can cancel the common factor of $$3$$ in the numerator and denominator because it is nonzero. \n $$\frac{3(3x)}{3(2-2x)}=\frac{3x}{2-2x}$$
